newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco opens new telecom services, PTT HQ.
newsitem.headline: Morocco opens new telecom services, PTT HQ.

text.p: Morocco's Crown Prince Sidi Mohammed on Thursday inaugurated a new national telecoms headquarters and specialised phones services worth $8.5 million, the official MAP news agency said.
The inauguration of the new headquarters coincided with the start of two sophisticated phone services aimed at boosting Morocco's telecoms competitiveness in the world market, MAP said.

"One service, called Rakkas, would be as bleeper system allowing immediate contact with people anywhere," Abdeslam Ahizoune, director-general of the Office Nationale des Postes et Telecommunications was quoted by MAP as saying.
The other service, known as Marnis, "a system to pass data, images and voice messages," he added. The two had a combined cost of 80 million dirhams ($8.5 million), MAP said.
With its 27 million population, Morocco has a density of four lines for 100 inhabitans including 30,000 GSM subscribers, officials said.
